# NZZ (Neue Zürcher Zeitung)

> > Swiss newspaper covering international affairs, geopolitics, Swiss domestic news, and sports with focus on Iran, Russia, Middle East conflicts, and European developments.

NZZ is a leading Swiss German-language newspaper providing comprehensive coverage of global events, Swiss politics, international relations, and cultural topics. The publication offers daily briefings, in-depth analysis, and topic pages covering major geopolitical developments, diplomatic relations, and regional news affecting Switzerland and the world.

## Key Topics

- Switzerland (Schweiz)
- Iran and Strait of Hormuz conflict
- Geopolitics and international relations
- Russia-Switzerland diplomatic relations
- Sergei Lawrow (Russian diplomat)
- Ignazio Cassis (Swiss Foreign Minister)
- Middle East conflicts (Israel, Iran, USA)
- Oil trade and energy security
- OSCE presidency
- Ukraine ceasefire negotiations
- Daily news briefings
- European affairs (Netherlands)
- Swiss domestic news (Zurich, Kerzers)
- Champions League football
- Moscow diplomatic visits

## Daily News Briefings

- [Briefing](https://www.nzz.ch/briefing/briefing-am-donnerstagmorgen-ld.1928924): Morning news roundup: Hormuz Strait conflict, Zurich speeding, Kerzers arson
- [Briefing am Mittwochabend](https://www.nzz.ch/briefing/briefing-am-mittwochabend-ld.1928879): Evening briefing: Merz on Iran, Swiss bus arson, Mojtaba Khamenei

## International Affairs & Diplomacy

- [Sergei Lawrow – Aktuelle News und alle Artikel zum russischen Diplomaten | NZZ](https://www.nzz.ch/themen/sergei-lawrow): Topic page covering Russian diplomat Sergei Lawrow and Switzerland relations
- [Niederlande – Alle News, Artikel und Informationen zum Thema | NZZ](https://www.nzz.ch/themen/niederlande): Topic page on Netherlands covering energy, data centers, and grid expansion

## Sports Coverage

- [FC Bayern vs. Bergamo: Olise glänzt beim 6:1-Torfestival](https://www.nzz.ch/sport/bayern-ueberrollen-mit-magischem-olise-bvb-schreck-bergamo-ld.1928718): Champions League: Bayern's 6:1 victory over Atalanta with Olise starring
